findings.title: Outdated OpenSSH version exposed
findings.plain_explanation: The scan found an SSH service reporting an old version. Old versions often have known bugs that newer releases fixed.
findings.risk: Attackers can look up known issues for this version and try them against the server.
remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to a currently supported release.
Restrict SSH access to trusted IP ranges with a firewall.
findings.verifier_notes: Port, service and version found in parsed Nmap data. Reported by scan, not confirmed exploitable.
